scope: Pareto candidate at the same finalized variance-plus-epsilon/mean/gamma/beta boundary as M235

innovation.name: tiny-LUT double-refinement barrier-slack coefficient engine
innovation.mechanism: Replace M235's 64-entry/one-Newton seed with a 16-entry/two-Newton seed while retaining one scalar multiplier; eight dependent products per pair target the M232 coefficient-service slack.
innovation.comparison_required: M236 versus M235 must use matched interface, technology, clock, DC and SAIF; no area, energy or Pareto superiority is admitted before that comparison.

fixed_formats.lut: 16 x unsigned 19-bit Q18 midpoint values; 8 bins over [1,2), 8 bins over [2,4)
fixed_formats.rounding: round-to-nearest ties-to-even after every declared multiply/shift

required_dc.reason: Runner is prepared but execution is serialized by the root thread to avoid concurrent DC.

fail_closed_exclusions: sum/sumsq/population division and finalized mean/variance production
moment state SRAM, address schedule and barrier cycles
runtime elementwise BN affine datapath and its input/output quantization
M167 PREFOLD and channel-major rank/raw-state replay
ATLIF threshold/event equivalence and BN2 residual equivalence
BN, FFN, network or system speedup
SRAM macro, PTPX energy, paper-ready PPA and headline claims
